findings.root_cause: F68 (Airport & local datetime correctness) was omitted from WP01 node capability list.
findings.locked_solution: Restore F68 into WP01.capabilities in CANONICAL_DAG.json and verify all 89 capability contracts with zero omissions.
findings.negative_counterexample: DAG check with 88 capabilities fails contract completeness assertion.
findings.implementation_evidence: CANONICAL_DAG.json updated; scripts/verify-farely-v17-contract.mjs check 8 asserts dag_capability_count === 89 and dagCaps.has('F68').

findings.root_cause: Historical altered mapping projection shortened original titles and priorities.
findings.locked_solution: Preserve all 89 authentic owner capability contracts F00..F88 in LOCKED_RESEARCH_CONTRACT.json and SEMANTIC_DRIFT_MATRIX.json.
findings.negative_counterexample: F21 title change or priority drift triggers check failure.
findings.implementation_evidence: docs/convergence/v17/SEMANTIC_DRIFT_MATRIX.json records all 34 discrepancies resolved; scripts/verify-farely-v17-contract.mjs verifies authentic titles.

findings.root_cause: Contract checker was not verifying DAG node capability completeness and uniqueness.
findings.locked_solution: Enforce automated verification of exact 89 capabilities with zero duplicate and zero missing.
findings.negative_counterexample: scripts/verify-farely-v17-contract.mjs fails if dagCaps.size !== 89.

findings.root_cause: Proof index could point to stale Git SHA.
findings.locked_solution: Evidence admission controller validates SHA alignment across git revision and proof capsules.
findings.negative_counterexample: NV19 & A19 test that mismatched proof revisions fail closed.
findings.implementation_evidence: Admission controller NV19 and A19 automated tests passing.

findings.root_cause: Self-referential checkpoint SHA pattern where checkpoint records guessed or stale SHA.
findings.locked_solution: Section 27 protocol: commit implementation first, record implementation SHA in checkpoint, commit checkpoint separately.
findings.negative_counterexample: Checkpoint containing forward SHA fails remote git validation.
findings.implementation_evidence: Two-stage commit protocol applied for V22 handoff.
findings.remaining_proof: Remote SHA equality verified via git ls-remote.

findings.root_cause: Historical tests tested synthetic mock algorithms instead of production modules.
findings.locked_solution: All 40 adversarial challenges (A01..A40) and 32 vertical journeys (J01..J32) import and exercise real src/domain/farely modules.
findings.negative_counterexample: A24: Toy-test function passes while production code remains broken is explicitly defended.
findings.implementation_evidence: scripts/v17-adversarial-challenges.node-test.mjs and scripts/v22-vertical-journeys.node-test.mjs exercise real production domain code.

findings.root_cause: Test entrypoints bypassed actual domain and migration constraints.
findings.locked_solution: Vertical journeys test real functions, RLS migrations, and canonical TravelIntent data structures.
findings.negative_counterexample: Failure to satisfy TravelIntent constraints produces explicit error (e.g. NC-006).
findings.implementation_evidence: 32 vertical journey tests executed and verified.
findings.remaining_proof: Green test execution across Node test runner.

findings.root_cause: Search filtering applied in-memory after partial paginated fetch could lose cheaper flights on later pages.
findings.locked_solution: Edge Function and routeBest evaluate candidate universe before windowing; filterDeals preserves whole set.
findings.negative_counterexample: J02: Cheapest offer at index 75 beyond first page is found and selected.
findings.implementation_evidence: selectRouteBest evaluates all 80 items in candidate universe; J02 passing.

findings.root_cause: RouteBest candidate denominator could exclude valid offers or mix incompatible scopes.
findings.locked_solution: evaluateOfferEligibility performs rigorous tri-state validation before mathematical min selection.
findings.negative_counterexample: A02 and J02 test denominator completeness.
findings.implementation_evidence: selectRouteBest in routeBest.ts enforces REQ-PRICE-002 mathematical minimum.

findings.root_cause: Estimated cost presented with excessive certainty without epistemics.
findings.locked_solution: Tri-state epistemic classification: KNOWN, ESTIMATED, OPTIONAL, UNKNOWN in costEpistemics.ts.
findings.negative_counterexample: A05: Unknown baggage fees cannot be treated as zero in cost epistemics.
findings.implementation_evidence: evaluateTrueCost calculates minVerifiableTotal and preserves hasUnknownMandatoryCost.

findings.root_cause: Number(row.stops) coerced null/undefined to 0 (nonstop), falsely asserting nonstop flight when stops was unknown.
findings.locked_solution: Preserve null in Deal.stops, mapObservedFare, mapDealRow, and filterDeals. Do not match maxStops: 0 when stops is null.
findings.negative_counterexample: A04 and NV04 assert unknown stops cannot satisfy direct flight constraint.
findings.implementation_evidence: Deal.stops typed as number | null; filterDeals checks d.stops == null || d.stops > maxStops; buildOfferVariantId uses UNKNOWN.

findings.root_cause: Query freshness sourced from global latest observation rather than query-scoped route.
findings.locked_solution: Freshness evaluated per-route scope; fresh Route A cannot hide stale Route B.
findings.negative_counterexample: A03 and NV03 assert independent route freshness tracking.

findings.root_cause: Full Watch demand missing from scanner prioritization.
findings.locked_solution: Watch records store last_checked_at as NULL on creation, prioritizing them for initial evaluation.
findings.negative_counterexample: Watches without evaluation get scheduled with top priority.

findings.root_cause: Watch mutation errors silently discarded without reporting.
findings.locked_solution: reportClientIssue invoked and error response returned with sync_failed status.
findings.negative_counterexample: A12: Server Watch mutation failure appears successful is defended.
findings.implementation_evidence: createWatch returns success: false with localized error message.

findings.root_cause: Watch return date was conflated with outbound departure window dateTo.
findings.locked_solution: Separate departDate (outbound) from returnDate in WatchModal and pass returnDate/journeyType to createWatch.
findings.negative_counterexample: A09 and NV09 verify returnDate does not change outbound departure window.
findings.implementation_evidence: WatchModal.tsx dateTo set to opportunity.departDate; returnDate passed explicitly; J12 passing.

findings.root_cause: Watch account data mixed through unisolated local cache across sign-ins.
findings.locked_solution: Scoped by authenticated user session id; RLS isolates remote records.
findings.negative_counterexample: A10 & NV10 test that User A Watch cannot leak to User B.
findings.implementation_evidence: J11 passing with strict tenant isolation.

findings.root_cause: Watch mutations lacking authoritative server acknowledgement.
findings.locked_solution: Mutations require explicit database response; failures trigger UI rollback.
findings.negative_counterexample: J13 verifies rollback to monitoring on server error.

findings.root_cause: Watch canonical TravelIntent not persisted end-to-end.
findings.locked_solution: user_alerts table stores return_date, trip_type, date_from, date_to, and max_stops.
findings.negative_counterexample: J12 verifies round-trip watch retains distinct inbound/outbound fields.

findings.root_cause: getDealById fell back only to getObservedFares(1, 120), failing to resolve deals beyond first 120.
findings.locked_solution: Direct indexed lookup in fare_observations table by exact id or opportunity_id without pagination limit.
findings.negative_counterexample: Opportunity ID beyond first page failing to resolve in detail view.
findings.implementation_evidence: getDealById queries supabase.from('fare_observations') directly by id or opportunity_id.

findings.root_cause: Saved items matching route/date rather than cryptographic OfferVariantId.
findings.locked_solution: Saved items reference durable OfferVariantId ov:v1:hash which survives generation rollover.
findings.negative_counterexample: A30 tests that saved items point to correct opportunity after migration.

findings.root_cause: Source date fallback from requested date could cause date drift.
findings.locked_solution: Observations bind strictly to provider-returned flight departure dates.
findings.negative_counterexample: A40: User input date is mistaken for provider-supplied date is defended.

findings.root_cause: Travelpayouts found_at / source-time parsing mismatch.
findings.locked_solution: Parse ISO timestamps strictly; observed_at retains provider observation timestamp.
findings.negative_counterexample: J23 verifies observed_at matches provider time, not client query time.

findings.root_cause: Provider result cap not disclosed as truncation.
findings.locked_solution: ProviderResult includes isDegraded and DEGRADED_COVERAGE status.
findings.negative_counterexample: A38: Partial scan is called all-market coverage is defended.

findings.root_cause: Alert coverage guessed from >=3 candidate rows without proper coverage certificate.
findings.locked_solution: Coverage qualification requires multi-epoch observations and explicit route coverage certificate.
findings.negative_counterexample: NODE OUTBOX-05 enforces qualified coverage certificate.

findings.root_cause: Alert processor unpaginated Watch/deal reads could truncate at 1,000 rows.
findings.locked_solution: Chunked pagination stream handles arbitrary watch volumes without truncation.
findings.negative_counterexample: J18 tests batch processing of 1,205 watches without truncation.

findings.root_cause: Date.now or weak condition fingerprint for logical episodes caused duplicate alerts.
findings.locked_solution: Durable episodes tracked via state machine (ENTERED, STILL_INSIDE, MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT, EXITED).
findings.negative_counterexample: A14: Concurrent outbox workers send duplicate logical alert is defended.

findings.root_cause: Provider HTTP 202 accepted mislabeled as delivered.
findings.locked_solution: HTTP 202 tracked as ACCEPTED_DISPATCHED; DELIVERED reserved for confirmed delivery webhooks.
findings.negative_counterexample: A13 & NV13 assert provider acceptance is NOT confirmed recipient delivery.

findings.root_cause: Historical 'lowest' claim made from insufficient sample size.
findings.locked_solution: Savings and baseline claims require minimum sample size and comparable cohort matching.
findings.negative_counterexample: A06: One scan manufactures strong historical confidence is defended.

findings.root_cause: Heuristic future-price probability displayed without statistical calibration.
findings.locked_solution: Uncalibrated predictions are gated and withheld from consumer-facing UI.
findings.negative_counterexample: J24 asserts uncalibrated model predictions are withheld.

findings.root_cause: Explore did not implement true budget-first discovery.
findings.locked_solution: Budget-first filter strictly bounds candidate discovery by budget ceiling (price <= budget).
findings.negative_counterexample: J25 verifies offer exceeding budget ceiling is rejected.

findings.root_cause: User-facing discount claims presented without compatible cohorts.
findings.locked_solution: buildComparableCohort matches on route, cabin, stopsClass, and date proximity.
findings.negative_counterexample: A21: F21 semantics change while all 89 IDs remain is defended.

findings.root_cause: Preview SHA could be inconsistent with source under evaluation.
findings.locked_solution: Release candidate tuple is bound cryptographically to exact source Git SHA.
findings.negative_counterexample: A18: Old worker SHA is treated as current release fails closed.

findings.root_cause: RLS / permissions not proven against live principals.
findings.locked_solution: RLS test suite and rpc-security-role tests prove anon/authenticated denial for privileged operations.
findings.negative_counterexample: scripts/rpc-security-role.node-test.mjs asserts anon execution denied on all 6 worker RPCs.
findings.implementation_evidence: 6 privileged RPC security role tests passing.

findings.root_cause: Data-provider commercial rights not independently tracked or proven.
findings.locked_solution: Provider operates strictly under MODE_1_INDICATIVE_PUBLIC_BETA with deep links; rights revocation disables commercial links.
findings.negative_counterexample: A29: Rights-revoked source remains commercially enabled is defended.

findings.root_cause: Price verification mismatch feedback was missing.
findings.locked_solution: When live recheck reveals price changes, explicit PRICE_CHANGED feedback is provided with price delta.
findings.negative_counterexample: J32 asserts source price change produces explicit user disclosure.
